s.note: Hancock throwing the beached whale back into the ocean
s.how: Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile high on a platter with lime wedges and pour over any butter left in the pan. Eat with your fingers.

s.note: Ray's All Heart pitch to the big companies
s.how: Slice 1 baguette and toast the slices. Dice 4 ripe tomatoes and mix with 1 crushed garlic clove, a handful of torn basil, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Rub the toasts with a cut garlic clove and pile the tomato on just before serving.

m.note: Ray giving Hancock a new public image
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry twice until crisp. Grill 4 sirloin steaks to medium-rare and rest. In the pan, toast cracked peppercorns, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Serve with the chips and a green salad.

w.note: Hancock learning to say good job
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes. Cut into squares and serve each warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Good job.

d.how: Fill short glasses with ice and pour 45ml whisky over for those drinking. For the sober version, brew strong black tea, cool it, and pour over ice with lemon slices. Either way, drink it slowly and keep your feet on the ground.
